message:
## Vulnerability Digest

No credible vulnerabilities newly reported or materially updated in the last 24 hours were confirmed as relevant to the assigned DLL/component inventory.

**Scope**

- Source: `DLL_software_component.txt` only; repeated component names and obvious naming variants were normalized and deduplicated.
- `Products.txt` and `List_of_SIA_Completed.txt` were not read or combined with this scan.
- Window: 2026-09-18 13:10 IST through 2026-09-19 13:10 IST (2026-09-18 07:40 UTC through 2026-09-19 07:40 UTC).

**Findings**

No in-window findings passed all freshness, credible-source, and product-match checks. Recent NuGet and npm advisory listings were reviewed, along with targeted searches for the named commercial and open-source components. Results published in the window concerned other products or packages and were excluded as non-matches.

**MongoDB ecosystem verification**

The dedicated sweep checked MongoDB Server Community and Enterprise, mongod, mongos, Atlas and Atlas services, Ops Manager, Cloud Manager, Compass, mongosh, Database Tools, Kubernetes Operator, official drivers and connectors, BI Connector and SQL Interface, Charts, Realm/App Services, official integrations, and major MongoDB-maintained libraries. The latest MongoDB-owned vulnerability entries located were dated September 17, 2026, before this run's cutoff, so they were excluded as stale.

Sources checked included the [MongoDB security alerts page](https://www.mongodb.com/resources/products/alerts), [GitHub Advisory Database for NuGet](https://github.com/advisories?query=ecosystem%3Anuget), [GitHub Advisory Database for npm](https://github.com/advisories?query=ecosystem%3Anpm), CISA alerts, NVD-indexed records, vendor advisories, and credible security reporting.

**Review priority**

No immediate review is recommended based on newly reported vulnerabilities in this monitoring window. Continue routine monitoring; this result does not assess older known vulnerabilities already applicable to the listed component versions.
